mentions.name: Diplomium
mentions.description: This SaaS platform helps educators and event organizers create and deliver authenticated certificates at scale. Users upload an Excel file, pick a template, and the system automatically generates and sends personalized certificates, each carrying a unique QR code for instant validation. Running for two years with schools and training centers in Latin America, it is now building AI-powered features for design editing and data extraction from PDFs, making credentials verifiable, permanent, and easy to distribute.
mentions.problem: Certificates are often the only tangible outcome of a learning experience, but manually designing and emailing PDF certificates costs organizations admin time and yields credentials that aren't easily verifiable or trustworthy for learners.
